observations: Photo 0: A cardboard box printed 'Nikon D750' and a yellow Nikon logo, sitting next to a box labeled 'NIKKOR LENS 50', with a third box in the background showing a gimbal/stabilizer image and a red 'LAB' sticker (possibly a Zhiyun gimbal box, per photo 1 barcode).
Photo 1: The D750 box opened, revealing only printed manuals ('D750 User's Manual' and an apparel/lens manual) sitting in plastic sleeves. No camera body or lens is visible.
Photo 2: Interior of a box showing bubble-wrapped lumps; shapes are not identifiable as a camera body, lens, or any specific item through the wrapping.
No photo in the set shows the actual camera body, lens glass, mount, LCD screen, serial number plate, or any unwrapped electronic device.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI - OLAJIDE AMOS BISHOP' appears on all three images.

identity.kind: DSLR camera body (seller claims Nikon D750)

claims.evidence: Only the retail box and manual are shown; no serial plate, import sticker, or the camera itself is visible in any photo.
No photo shows the physical camera body's shell, LCD, mount, or sensor to assess cosmetic condition.
No power-on screen, shutter count, test shot, or video clip provided; the camera itself is never shown unwrapped.

risks.risk: Box and manuals may not correspond to an actual working D750 body inside — common 'empty box' or mismatched-contents resale pattern.
risks.proof: A clear unobstructed photo of the camera body itself, outside any wrapping, showing lens mount, LCD screen, and top info display powered on.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional / unconfirmed body (worst case, potentially no camera at all)

risks.risk: Shutter count and sensor condition unknown, which heavily affects used DSLR value.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a diagnostic tool or a clear photo of the LCD info/menu screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced at low end as heavy-use/unknown wear

risks.risk: Bundled items (50mm lens, gimbal) may not be included in the actual sale or may belong to a different listing photo.
risks.proof: A single photo showing all items side by side, unwrapped, with the seller's handwritten note/date for proof of current possession.

risks.risk: 'American used' import claim cannot be confirmed, affecting warranty/grey-market status.
risks.proof: Photo of any import sticker, region code, or purchase receipt.
risks.if_unproven: priced as ungraded import, no warranty assumed

proof_requests: Photo of the actual camera body unwrapped, lens mount and LCD visible
Photo of the top/rear screen powered on showing shutter count or menu
Photo of serial number sticker on the body matching the box serial
A short video of the camera powering on and shutter firing
response.reason: All three photos show only packaging, manuals, and bubble wrap — the actual camera body is never shown, which is a classic pattern for box-only or empty-box scams rather than genuine used-item listings.
